Seconds between commits of what you have seen into the map's history. Shorter keeps a finer time-lapse and costs more disk.
config.palimpsest.minimapEnabled.tooltip: Whether the minimap starts shown; its key toggles it until you leave the game.
config.palimpsest.minimapSize.tooltip: Side of the minimap, in GUI pixels.
config.palimpsest.minimapCoordinates.too: Whether your coordinates show under the minimap.
config.palimpsest.minimapRotation.toolti: Whether the minimap and the big map keep north up or turn so you always face up.
config.palimpsest.bigMapOpacity.tooltip: How opaque the big map is while its key is held, in percent.
